title: Kelvin–Helmholtz billows
alt: A pale band of dye between two shear layers whose edges roll up into rows of spirals, outlined by a thin yellow-green line.
caption: Passive dye between two shear layers rolling up, Re = 400, t = 2 to 9.95. 384 × 192 Fourier modes, RK443, dt = 0.0025, CPU.

title: Rossby–Haurwitz wave
alt: A turning globe on black covered by large alternating red and green vorticity lobes, four around each hemisphere, travelling east.
caption: Relative vorticity of the wavenumber-4 Rossby–Haurwitz wave (Williamson et al. 1992, case 6) in inviscid shallow water on the rotating sphere, over one period of the wave (7.8 days, from day 4), seen from 35° N by a camera turning against it. T63, RK443, dt = 0.03/Ω, CPU.
